instruction: Stop VLC from showing the currently playing file name in the window title bar, and make sure the setting persists across restarts.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'qt-name-in-title', default: '1' } ] }); return data[0]; }
